diagnostics.message: `aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization` only depends on `aws_iam_role.config_organization` (through `role_arn`), but not on `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization`. Creating an organization-source aggregator immediately exercises the role (AWS Config calls EnableAwsServiceAccess against AWS Organizations), so the `AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations` policy must already be attached. Both the AWS and Terraform registry examples for organization aggregation include an explicit `depends_on` on the role-policy attachment for exactly this reason. Without it, the aggregator can be created before the role has any permissions and creation fails with an insufficient-permissions error. Add `depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization]` to `aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization`.
